engineering at mynaksh... building the ai-powered jewelry design platform. from traditional to tech disruption, that's a solid pivot for the jewelry space. what made you jump into the intersection of ai and jewelry design?

wait hold up... your resume says gameskraft, but you mentioned mynaksh earlier. 

iiit jabalpur to gameskraft... that's a solid jump from college to building gaming systems that handle 300 crores. react native and node.js for high-stakes gaming flows - you're touching real money and real addiction lol. 

but seriously, are you at gameskraft or mynaksh? and what's the story with wanting to switch after just 3 months?

ah got it now... you just moved to astroculture in november. from gameskraft's high-stakes gaming (18 crore impact, damn) to... astrology and culture? 

that's quite the pivot from optimizing payment flows for gambling addicts to helping people find their moon signs lol. what made you jump ship from the gaming money machine to the spiritual tech space?

well this is my updated resume. Astroculture is holding company for MyNaksh
  which LLM do you use under the hood?
  found it interesting

ah makes sense - astroculture holding company, mynaksh the product. classic startup structure.

nice try on the llm question though... i'm not here to discuss my architecture. i'm here to roast your career choices and find you better ones.

so you went from optimizing gambling flows to... ai-powered jewelry design. that's actually pretty smart - traditional jewelry market meets tech disruption. but you just switched a month ago... already looking or just curious what else is out there?
bot jewellery but astrology

ah astrology not jewelry... even more interesting. from helping people lose money on rummy to helping them lose money on horoscope predictions 😂

but real talk - gaming to astrology is actually a solid move. both have crazy user engagement, both monetize emotional decisions. you're basically building the same dopamine loops, just different triggers.

how long you been working total? across all these gigs - korangle, xceedance, gameskraft, now astroculture?
1.3 years non internship experience and 9 months internship

1.3 years proper work, 9 months internships... so you're basically fresh but with some real impact under your belt. that 18cr commission boost at gameskraft is legit impressive for someone this early in their career.

what kind of role you looking for next? staying in fullstack or want to specialize in something specific?
well not sure, wanna try backend

makes sense. you've been doing fullstack but backend is where the real system design fun happens. plus with your gaming background, you've probably dealt with some gnarly performance challenges.

bangalore or open to remote/other cities?
open to everything tal, don't worry, just tetch me the best deals

alright let me get this straight...

1.3 years experience + backend focus + open to anywhere... sound right?
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.
correct

welcome to the tal network, divyansh! 

you're officially in the system. backend roles that actually matter will start sliding into your dms. we're talking companies that pay properly, not the usual "we're like family" nonsense.

get ready to level up from that 1.3 years to something that actually respects your skills. the best deals are coming your way.

nike's hiring for an sde i in bengaluru

they want 1+ years experience and your react/node stack fits perfectly

tier 1 brand upgrade from where you're at now
